description: Generate a smart travel packing checklist by trip type and length — quantities scale with your days and travelers, then check items off.

faqs.a: Yes — pick Beach, Business, City break, Camping, Skiing, Backpacking, Cruise or Road trip and the base list adapts with trip-specific gear.
faqs.q: Does it adapt to the trip type?

faqs.a: Clothing quantities are computed from your trip length (e.g. one shirt per day plus a spare), and most shared items scale with the traveler count.
Check items off as you pack; your checklist state stays on this page while it is open.
Fully private — everything is generated and stored only in your browser.

howto: Choose your trip type, length in days and number of travelers.
Tick the categories you want included.
Generate the list, check items off as you pack, and download it for offline use.
title: Packing List Generator
